prioritySystem.weightMeaning: Historical priority metadata describes responsibility only; it does not allocate attention, tokens, shots, actions or scores.

tiers.rule: Respect user scope, plot facts, frozen speech, real assets, permissions and provider boundaries; chapter authors may omit non-plot detail without losing plot.
A viewer can understand the plot, motives needed for it, causes and important results from the delivered sound and image.
Preserve story-relevant states across continuous action or express the authorized time and scene transition.
Choose sufficient execution details for this scene; no single-change rule, motion requirement or fixed technique.
Select relevant methods freely; examples do not define facts, fixed routines or quotas.
Optional expression supports the story without crowding out necessary plot.

reviewerChecks: Examples are optional; only successfully read bodies are attributed, with their exact source receipts.

artifactScope.tapcanvas.clip-production-packet/v2: Author scene and ordered shots with action, camera, sound, storyEventIds and speechEventIds. No per-shot durations, speech seconds or clock-derived references. The provider request owns whole-clip duration; the video model adapts intra-clip pacing.
